tasks.short: Diagnose and treat dependency and related cognitive conditions

steps.what: Diagnose and treat dependency-related or exposure-related conditions within neuropsychological scope

tasks.design: Retain formulation and treatment with the neuropsychologist working with appropriate medical colleagues. Existing {DOCS} supports access to evidence; no clinical decision is delegated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Symptoms and cognitive changes can have several interacting causes.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported automation of this clinical task is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing causes and coordinating suitable treatment.
tasks.human_edge: Clinical judgement and an effective therapeutic relationship.

reach.learn: How cognitive limitations affect treatment participation

evidence.claim: Documentation assistance does not demonstrate automatic diagnosis or treatment of these conditions.

assumptions: Direct clinical work is in scope; separate report composition is excluded.
Current assessment produces the findings; no free structured diagnosis or risk flags are assumed.
Use current clinical systems and referral routes.
No incremental upkeep because the clinical workflow is unchanged.
unknowns: Local clinical scope and referral arrangements
research_questions: Which missing clinical evidence most often delays formulation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; no clinical intervention time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define neuropsychological research questions, protocol, measures and analysis choices
Collect research observations and verify dataset provenance, coding and missingness
Run specified analyses and compile reproducible research tables
Interpret disorders research, investigate diagnostics and assess limitations before accepting findings

tasks.design: Reuse validated analysis scripts in {DATA_PLATFORM} to reduce repeated table assembly after the researcher specifies methods and checks data. Study design, observation, diagnostic review and interpretation retain their time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual table production makes reruns slow and inconsistent.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned analysis scripts and standard statistical software already support repeatable calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing valid methods and interpreting findings without overstating causality.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher connects design limitations with clinical meaning.

evidence.claim: Versioned statistical scripts can repeat specified calculations and assemble tables; study design and scientific interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is a research study, not only literature screening; participant work and scientific interpretation stay counted.

The neuropsychologist produces variables, coding, inclusion rules, missing-data policy and planned analyses in s1. In s2 they capture participant study identifier, observation dates, measure version, raw values, source reference and missingness reason; the full capture and verification time remains counted.
Missing provenance or unresolved coding stops analysis for manual correction. No synthetic observations or automatically inferred diagnoses fill gaps.
Test native analysis scripting and table export before new code; current software runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: How much table assembly is still manual after validated analyses run?

incremental.description: Script validation and revision between studies

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10%; minus 5 focal upkeep gives net 5%. Range 0-2% covers existing scripted analyses and limited repeatable table work; unmeasured E1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Collaborate with medical scientists on study validity
role.ambitious_version: Research calculations are reproducible while clinical and scientific judgement remain explicit.
